s: El-Baz (Arabic: الباز, Hebrew: אלבז, also spelled Elbaz, Al-Baz, El Baze, Albaz or ElBez (Arabic pronunciation: [elˈbæːz]) is an Arabic surname, meaning "the hawk" or "the falcon" ("Baz" refers to the goshawk in Arabic, and to a falcon or kestrel in Hebrew).

el-Shennawi (Arabic: الشناوي, also transliterated as al-Shinnawi) is an Arabic family name, when followed by a sun letter, the l in el assimilates to the initial consonant of the following noun, resulting in a doubled consonant.
